aspect: EXAMPLE - the official warning about agents
description: Nigeria's diaspora commission, explaining a case of travellers refused entry in South Africa, said visa agents complete application sections without travellers' full knowledge, leaving applicants unable to verify their own information when questioned at the port of entry.
energy_note: Interrogated about answers you never gave.

aspect: The applicant carries the consequence, not the agent
description: A discrepancy between what the form says and what the traveller says is treated as deception by the traveller. The agent is not present, not named and not liable.
energy_note: Accused of lying about a sentence someone else typed.

aspect: And a misrepresentation finding is long-lived
description: A finding of deception can carry a multi-year bar in several jurisdictions - a penalty far exceeding the refusal itself, arising from an error the applicant may not have known existed.
energy_note: A decade barred, over someone else's typing.

description: The agent said he would 'strengthen' her application. At the interview the officer asks about a NGN 14 million balance she has never had. She says she does not recognise it. The refusal is recorded as misrepresentation and carries a ten-year bar.
energy_note: A decade barred, for a number she never typed.
